metadata.name: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 (Protecting CUI)
metadata.description: NIST SP 800-171 provides 110 security requirements across 14 families for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in nonfederal systems and organizations. US Government public-domain publication.
metadata.source_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
metadata.framework_purpose: Protect the confidentiality of Controlled Unclassified Information in nonfederal systems.
metadata.framework_scope: Nonfederal systems and organizations that process, store, or transmit CUI (e.g., DoD contractors).
metadata.target_audience: CISOs, ISSOs, DoD/defense contractors, GRC and security teams
